item.title: Modeling for fabrication: parametric and sculptural
item.description: Two modeling attitudes: parametric CAD (Fusion 360) and mesh/sculptural (Blender); parameters, constraints, families of objects; scanning as input (photogrammetry).

learningObjectives.item: Build a parametric model whose dimensions change without remodeling
Capture and clean a scanned form

item.content:
Two modeling attitudes: parametric CAD (Fusion 360) and mesh/sculptural (Blender); parameters, constraints, families of objects; scanning as input (photogrammetry).

Ideas

Parametric design and the object as a family (Carpo: variable, identical, differential); form + code; scanning and the digital copy.

In class

  • Lecture (30 min)
  • parametric tutorial (60 min)
  • scan demo (30 min)
  • work (60 min)
